blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A leading member of the People’s Budget Coalition (PBC) welcomed Speaker Faustino “Bojie” Dy III’s commitment to greater transparency and accountability in the national budget process and to working with civil society groups to achieve those goals. In a Facebook post, Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante, a PBC member, thanked Dy for meeting with budget watchdogs and acknowledging areas where the House could improve its procedures for scrutinizing and disclosing government projects. “Thank you, Speaker Faustino ‘Bojie’ Dy III, for meeting with the People’s Budget Coalition last Wednesday, acknowledging the points for improvement in the House process, and committing […]...
